proposedBy: fix:release-loop-tooling:r3 (branch release-loop/release-loop-tooling-fix-r3, fe190e2) and owner direction 2026-10-09 (specGovernance, definition v4)
reason: Before spec governance existed, fix round 3 edited this spec directly (fe190e2). Under definition v4 those edits cannot merge as-is; they are filed here for review instead. Definition v4 also adds a role, a stage and a gate, so J1.1's exact expected output changes. Reviewer split the sync-setup-guide check into new cli step J5.5.

changes.tracesTo: definition.json v4 specGovernance (owner direction 2026-10-09): role release_spec_reviewer, stage amend, gate baseline
changes.whyNeeded: The definition changed by owner direction; the old expected output describes v3.

changes.before: Expect eight tiles ... `1` Finished with unreconciled failures, `391 / 20k` Tokens out / cache read. / charlie-export Failed
changes.after: Expect nine tiles ... `1` Finished with unreconciled failures, a Status updates tile whose value is the `version` of the last entry of `updates` in `$FX/snap.json` (`—` when `updates` is empty), `391 / 20k` Tokens out / cache read. / charlie-export Agent stopped

changes.reviewerNote: Reviewer tightened the proposed wording so the tile value is checkable against the snapshot (updates come from docs/release-log/updates.json, which changes between releases, so a fixed literal would not be deterministic).

changes.before: Expect no console errors, no page errors, no failed requests, and scrollWidth equals clientWidth.
changes.after: The Board/World switch and the trends panel belong to the live-release-tracker spec and are not tested here. Expect no console errors, no page errors, no failed requests, and `document.documentElement.scrollWidth` equals `clientWidth`.
changes.tracesTo: Feature split: live-release-tracker owns World view and trends
changes.whyNeeded: States scope so the validator does not test another feature's controls.

changes.tracesTo: Owner direction: Salt Basin design tokens (cream #F8F4EC) from the uploaded design system

changes.after: `scrollWidth` equals `clientWidth`. On the overview the echo-audit status pill reads `Stalled (no sign of life)`, never the raw word `stalled`, and is styled like the `Agent stopped` pill (failure style), not unstyled. At 390 px no table needs sideways scroll ...
changes.tracesTo: Round-3 defects: raw 'stalled' label; SETUP-FOR-CLAUDE.md drifting from index.html

changes.reviewerNote: Reviewer removed the cli sync-setup-guide check from this browser step and made it J5.5, as the proposer suggested; 'in red' replaced by a checkable reference style.

changes.after: `node tools/release-tracker/sync-setup-guide.mjs` exits 0 and prints `SETUP-FOR-CLAUDE.md embedded page matches index.html`.
